categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Extek Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of high-efficiency heat exchangers. Its product portfolio includes shell-and-tube heat exchangers, coaxial tube heat exchangers, falling film heat exchangers, evaporative condensers, liquid cooling radiators, and distributors. These products serve as core components for heat pumps and air conditioning systems, widely applied in heating, hot water, refrigeration, data centers, and industrial and agricultural production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies in product design, manufacturing processes, and testing analysis for high-efficiency heat exchangers. Key innovations include patented multi-head spiral tube structures, integrated distributor-collector-heat exchanger welding technology, and advanced heat transfer enhancement techniques. Production emphasizes modular, standardized designs suitable for mass production with high reliability, durability, and environmental compliance, including certifications like ISO9001, UL, PED, and ASME.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are leading domestic and international manufacturers of heat pumps, commercial and residential air conditioning, and industrial cooling systems. Notable clients include Haier, Midea, Gree, McQuay, York, Trane, Carrier, Daikin, Hitachi, and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries. End markets span building heating and cooling, industrial processes, data center cooling, and agricultural applications, with a focus on energy-efficient and low-carbon solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with domestic sales accounting for over 99% of revenue. It has a limited but growing presence in overseas markets. The headquarters and production facilities are located in Zhejiang Province, China, with subsidiaries in Zhejiang and other regions. The company aims to expand its global market share through enhanced production capacity and brand recognition.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Extek Technology functions primarily as a midstream manufacturer and supplier of specialized heat exchanger components. It supplies critical parts to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in the HVAC and industrial sectors. The company does not engage in upstream raw material extraction nor downstream end-product assembly but focuses on component innovation and production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D to enhance heat exchanger efficiency, reliability, and environmental performance, aligning with national carbon neutrality goals. Key R&D projects include high-temperature water coaxial tube heat exchangers, R290 refrigerant-compatible plate heat exchangers, high-temperature steam heat exchangers, and advanced liquid cooling radiators for data centers. Collaborations with universities and research institutes support innovation in heat transfer mechanisms, numerical simulation, and energy-saving technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of heat exchanger products and related components to OEM customers. The company employs a direct sales model complemented by limited distribution channels. Income is recognized upon product delivery and customer acceptance, with a focus on product sales rather than services or licensing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading and influential manufacturer within the specialized heat exchanger segment in China. It competes with both domestic and international suppliers serving major HVAC and industrial clients. Its competitive advantages stem from proprietary technologies, high product quality, and strong partnerships with top-tier customers. The company has been recognized as an excellent component supplier by industry associations and maintains a strong market share in coaxial and shell-and-tube heat exchangers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 525 million, representing a 7.4% decrease from the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 59.4 million, down 41.25% year-over-year. The company has a registered capital of RMB 127.6 million and total assets exceeding RMB 1.3 billion. Despite recent revenue contraction, the company continues to invest significantly in R&D and production capacity expansion, supported by proceeds from its 2023 IPO.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Extek Technology emphasizes high-efficiency, reliable, and environmentally friendly heat exchanger products that improve energy utilization and reduce refrigerant leakage risks. Its patented designs enhance heat transfer performance and durability, supporting the transition to low-carbon heating and cooling solutions. The company’s products are tailored for advanced refrigerants and demanding applications like data center cooling, offering customers superior quality, innovation, and service reliability.
